sources.title: ToMeSD
sources.accessed_scope: Official CVF paper page and author implementation context.
sources.useful_mechanism: Diffusion token merging predates this work; merging itself is not novel.

sources.title: ToMA
sources.accessed_scope: Official ICML2025/PMLR article and method description.
sources.useful_mechanism: GPU-friendly attention-style merge/unmerge, facility-location formulation and reuse of merging patterns matter.
sources.boundary: Published generation latency and model settings cannot stand in for complete Wan FFN1.5x.

sources.title: ResCa
sources.accessed_scope: Author project and official CVF abstract; official code README. Full CVF PDF unavailable in this session.
sources.useful_mechanism: Residual-aware proxy tokens depend on dense-step history; same-step pooled input is a different causal setup.
sources.boundary: 5.5xGFLOPs is not measured Wan complete-FFN wall time; no inferred paper equations beyond accessed source.

sources.title: DaTMe
sources.useful_mechanism: Denoising/spatial importance and anchor protection already exist.
sources.boundary: Current step output/clean estimate is after whole step, not a free before-W1 signal; no transferred Wan evidence.

sources.title: Statistically Calibrated Scaling
sources.useful_mechanism: Token merging can distort both energy and distribution; statistical fixes have prior art.
sources.boundary: Attention reconstruction is not coupled HiF4 FFN mean-response accuracy.

sources.title: Exact Gaussian Moment Matching
sources.accessed_scope: Primary full HTML including formulation/limitations and GeLU appendix pointers;20 mean checks independently computed.
sources.useful_mechanism: Gaussian activation moments and covariance propagation are established tools.
sources.boundary: Gaussian/smooth activation results do not include group64 discontinuous Q2 or arbitrary four-token empirical distributions.

sources.title: MP-GELU
sources.boundary: Modified BNN activation and regression scope; not a license to replace frozen tanh-GELU/HiF4.

novelty_status: No originality claim for token merging, conditional anchors, Gaussian moments or cubature. The own-affine/joint-cubature/conditional-placement construction needs native usefulness and nearest-prior-art review.
